description_for_human: Fast, private offline video-to-audio converter with zero server uploads.
description_for_model: In-browser video-to-audio converter utility running via WebAssembly FFmpeg. Extracts audio tracks from MP4, MKV, AVI, WEBM, MOV, FLV, WMV, HEVC, and M4V to MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA, OPUS, AIFF locally with zero server uploads.
